name: Quest 6788: Bingles offers Bingles' Missing Supplies once Find Bingles is done
contract: Issue 6788: Bingles Blastenheimer (6577) in Loch Modan offered no quest to a level 18 character. Bingles' Missing Supplies (2038, levels 15/12, Alliance) has PrevQuestID 2039 in quest_template_addon (ACDB base, as in vanilla), so it opens only after Find Bingles (2039), which Gnoarn (6569) gives in Ironforge and Bingles takes back. Expected: before Find Bingles, 2039 is takeable and 2038 is not; after Find Bingles is rewarded, 2038 is takeable and Bingles' quest menu lists it. Client rendering is not tested.
